sort_by.description:
Sort by options for packs for hub.

- `title`: sort by the title of the pack.
- `created_at`: sort by when the pack is created.
- `total_members`: sort by the amount of members in the pack.
- `total_treets`: sort by the amount of treets in the pack.
- `price`: sort by the price of the pack.
sort_by.title: HubPackSortBy

anyOf.title: HubMemberTreetRole
anyOf.description:
The access role of a Hub member in terms of Treet access.

This is simplified compared to the main Hub roles, as here we only
care about access to Treets.

- `write`: roles that can write to the hub
- `read`: roles that can only read from the hub

inverse_treet_filter.description: If true and treet_id is given, it will return all packs not containing treet. If false and treet_id is given only shows packs containing treet.
inverse_treet_filter.title: Inverse Treet Filter

include_draft.description: If true includes draft packs. If false does not include draft packs. Default is false.
include_draft.title: Include Draft

treet_amount.description: If set, will return packs based on treet_amount_comparator.
treet_amount.title: Treet Amount

treet_amount_comparator.description: Comparator for amount of treets (tac). When treets_amount is set and a pack has x treets it will return packs that have `treet_amount (tac) x` for example `10 > x` will give packs with more than 10 treets.
treet_amount_comparator.title: AmountTreetsComparator

hub_id.description: Filter by owner of pack. If not given, no filter is applied
hub_id.title: Hub Id

category_id.description: ID of category to fetch treets with.
category_id.title: Category Id

title.description: Filter by title of pack. If not given, no filter is applied.
title.title: Title

total_treets_get_expired.description: If true it will only count expired Treets. If false it will only count active Treets. If not given, no filter is applied. The filter will only be applied if embedding total_treets. This filter will also affect the treet_amount filter and the values used when sorting by amount of treets.
total_treets_get_expired.title: Total Treets Get Expired

total_treets_get_archived.description: If true it will only count archived Treets. If false it will count active and archived Treets. If not given, no filter is applied. The filter will only be applied if embedding total_treets. This filter will also affect the treet_amount filter and the values used when sorting by amount of treets.
total_treets_get_archived.title: Total Treets Get Archived

medium_threshold_expires_at.description: Threshold for expires at in days to be medium.
medium_threshold_expires_at.title: Medium Threshold Expires At

critical_threshold_expires_at.description: Threshold for expires at in days to be critical.
critical_threshold_expires_at.title: Critical Threshold Expires At

medium_threshold_redeems_left.description: Threshold for redeems left as a percentage to be medium. Ex: if 20, then for redeem limit of 10 and 2 redeems left (2/10=20%), it will be medium. But redeem limit of 5 and 2 redeems left (2/5=40%) is not.
medium_threshold_redeems_left.title: Medium Threshold Redeems Left

critical_threshold_redeems_left.description: Threshold for redeems left as a percentage to be critical. Ex: if 20, then for redeem limit of 10 and 2 redeems left (2/10=20%), it will be critical. But redeem limit of 5 and 2 redeems left (2/5=40%) is not.
critical_threshold_redeems_left.title: Critical Threshold Redeems Left

treet_share_access.description: Treet share access the pack should have.

items.title: TreetShareAccess
items.description:
The access level of a Treet share for packs.

- `none`: Only members can receive treets from the pack
- `one_level`: Members can share treets from the pack
- `reshares`: Users receiving treets from anyone can share them

treet_share_access.title: Treet Share Access

embed_total_treets.description: Amount of treets in pack. Must be true when sorting by it.
embed_total_treets.title: Embed Total Treets

embed_total_members.description: Amount of members in pack. Must be true when sorting by it.
embed_total_members.title: Embed Total Members

embed_hub.description: Embed the hub owner of the Pack.
embed_hub.title: Embed Hub
